item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
Omar uses a circuit tester with a cell, a bulb, and wires. He joins aluminium between the free ends and the bulb glows. The tester wires have rubber covering. He also has a piece of dull copper.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Aluminium is a good conductor of electricity because the bulb glows when the tester circuit is complete.
options.B: Touching live metal parts is unsafe because metals that make the tester bulb glow can conduct electricity.
options.C: Aluminium is a poor conductor because in another try the bulb stayed off when a tester wire was disconnected.
options.D: Dull copper must be a poor conductor because it is not shiny.
